authorization: User asked to continue after the completed small-sample MIC baseline; this version authorizes evidence expansion audits only, retaining strict scientific boundaries.
scope: Follow-up exploratory primary-source MIC evidence expansion; no new model fitting, external validation, dual-task release, deployment or submission authorization.

design_context.research_stage: follow-up exploration, not a retroactive preregistration of the completed baseline

themes: antimicrobial peptide Escherichia coli MIC Wang resin
antimicrobial peptide Escherichia coli MIC free carboxyl terminus
proline rich peptide Escherichia coli MIC free acid
peptide dataset Escherichia coli minimum inhibitory concentration synthesis
search.date_range: all publication dates available at the recorded search time
search.screen_order: source retrieval order recorded in the search ledger; no ordering by model scores or MIC-derived label
search.selection_unit: a primary measurement study and all its peptide rows with traceable E. coli MIC endpoints
search.duplicate_studies: record and join publication aliases; prior reviewed studies are not new independent evidence

evidence_requirements: Original measurement article or supplement with sequence and chemical-form support; database annotations and predictions remain discovery leads only
Identified Escherichia coli strain or isolate and MIC endpoint
Raw concentration with censoring marker, unit, experimental conditions as reported and precise source locator
Explicit free N terminus and free carboxyl C terminus or unambiguous synthesis evidence for the actually measured molecule
Record raw source URL, retrieval time, checksum, license text and unresolved reuse restrictions
Review all corresponding peptide rows in a selected study; retain missing, conflicting and excluded observations

molecule_domain.modifications: none; free N terminus and C-terminal carboxyl; unsupported chemistry is excluded or withheld

label_rule.raw_measurement_normalization: linear canonical average molecular weight; preserve original censoring inequalities
label_rule.conflicts: merge exact unmodified molecules and retain all observed endpoints; incompatible derived labels or unresolved source conflicts prevent whole-molecule release

grouping_and_validation.similarity: inherit protocol-mic-06 exact global alignment scores, tie breaking and alignment-column identity
grouping_and_validation.comparison_scope: all unique admitted candidate molecules including the existing 15
grouping_and_validation.groups: transitive closure of all homology edges plus all primary-measurement study aliases
grouping_and_validation.evaluation_scope: feasibility audit only, no model fitting

release_gate: Candidate eligibility decisions and complete evidence review must precede partitioning. This audit cannot release any new molecule for training; separate complete evidence release and a new immutable training protocol are mandatory. Failed evidence or structural gates remain blocked without mutating the existing completed baseline.
